style.note: 参考: モノクロ高コントラスト。衣装は全員、細身のワイシャツとスラックス（体のラインが分かるもの）。モデル自体は自然な色の写実で作り、モノクロ化は Max 側で行う（プロンプトで白黒を指定すると肌まで石膏像のようになるため）。
style.suffix: full body, photorealistic adult human musician, lifelike face and skin, realistic hands and fingers, accurate anatomy and proportions, natural performing posture, detailed realistic fabric folds, accurately shaped real orchestral instrument, instrument clearly separated from the body
style.texture_prompt: photorealistic, natural human skin tones with pores and subtle variation, realistic hair, real cloth fabric with soft folds, real wood, polished brass and metal on the instrument, neutral even lighting, no baked shadows

wardrobe.shirt: wearing a slim-fit white dress shirt tucked into slim dark charcoal slacks, close-fitting to show the body line, black dress shoes
